title: Missing Man, Part 1
description: Missing Man, Part 1 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Reele

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Sir Reele went missing in the Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom off Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace. Find him.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Reele

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Missing Man, Part 2

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Sir Reele went missing in the Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom off Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace. Find him.

Offer:

If I *were* an agent of K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S.--and I'm not admitting that I am--but if I was, I would probably mention that Sir Reele was searching for secret documents when he went missing in the Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom. That's the sub-level off of Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace dungeon. And I might also mention that I'd pay anyone who discovered his fate and completed his task. But I'm clearly not an agent of K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S., so I won't be saying such things. *wink!*

Turn-in:

I died in the Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom, but for some reason I haven't resurrected yet! Are you here to rescue me?

Level range: 45–100
